outcome: duration of total breast milk feeding
cohort: The study evaluated 173 preterm infants who were born at less than 37 weeks gestation and hospitalized in a neonatal intensive care unit.
finding: The study found that exclusive breastfeeding at discharge was significantly associated with exclusive breastfeeding at 4 and 6 months, and total breast milk feeding duration was positively correlated with gestational age, birthweight, APGAR scores, and maternal age, but negatively correlated with NICU length of stay and intubation time.
followup_time: up to 24 months (with primary follow-up within the first year of life)
